module_summary: Three-requester fixed-priority arbiter: a 4-state FSM (idle plus one grant state per device) holds grant until request drops.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Idle A or grant-held state B/C/D; priority r0>r1>r2 chosen from idle.

anchors.name: r
anchors.why: Per-device request vector driving grant decisions and release.

anchors.name: g
anchors.why: One-hot grant vector decoded from grant states.

groups.name: priority_arbiter
groups.description: Fixed-priority grant FSM; grant held while requester keeps r[i] high.
